topics.label: Course Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This section welcomes the students, introduces the scope of the cancer biology lecture series, and outlines the primary learning outcomes.

topics.label: Cellular and Developmental Origins of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer develops from accumulated molecular alterations and the breakdown of normal tissue differentiation and cellular architecture.

topics.label: Tumor Progression, Invasion, and Classification
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tumors progress from precursor lesions to invasive disease and how neoplasms are classified and named based on their pathological behavior.

topics.label: Pathophysiology, Mortality, and Cancer Incidence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the mechanisms of cancer-induced morbidity and death while evaluating the patterns of tumor incidence across tissues, populations, and animal species.

topics.label: Principles and Applications of Cancer Screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics assess the clinical rationale, histological basis, and comparative effectiveness of screening programs across different cancer types.

topics.label: Lecture Wrap-Up and Next Steps
topics.groupedBecause: This section concludes the presentation by referencing the learning outcomes and providing logistical details for the upcoming practical sessions.
